# GRYT Run Club

> A Pittsburgh run club for former athletes, busy parents, and comeback runners. Saturdays at 7 AM on the Montour / Peters Trail in McMurray, PA. Walk, jog, or run — no pace requirement, no one gets dropped.

GRYT is a free Saturday-morning community run. The mission is simple: do hard things together. Members coordinate through Strava and show up rain or shine.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What GRYT is, when and where we run, how to show up, and FAQ.
- [Resources](/resources): Hub for playbooks, conversations, and graphics that help other run clubs get started.
- [Playbooks](/resources/playbooks): Step-by-step guides for starting and running a community run club.
- [Conversations](/resources/conversations): Interviews and Q&As with founders and community members.
- [Graphics](/resources/graphics): Downloadable logos, posters, pace cards, and social kits.
- [Waiver](/waiver): Liability waiver for first-time runners.
